# Product Markup Prices (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `Product Markup Prices` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 2 actions on 1 resources, 2 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-product-markupprices) | `GET /product/markupprices?ProductID={ProductID}` |
| [PUT](#put-product-markupprices) | `PUT /product/markupprices` |

+ ***This is a planned API and is not availabe yet***
+ Product Markup Prices CRUD operations. Markup prices determine the rules how to automatically calculate product price basing on specified rules.

## Markup Prices Model
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`ProductID`|GUID||Yes|Identifier of a product to which these markup prices belong to|
|`MarkupPrices`|<a href="#MarkupPriceLineModel"><b>[] Markup Price Line Model</b></a>||Yes|Array of markup price lines for each price tier. If price tier has no markup line, `MarkupType` will be set to `D`.|

## Markup Price Line Model <a id="MarkupPriceLineModel"></a>
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`TierNumber`|Small Integer||Yes|Price Tier index as it appears in Product management page. Valid values are from 1 up to 10 inclusively|
|`MarkupType`|String||Yes|Markup calculation type. Possible values are: `P` - new price will equal to start price increased by `MarkupValue` %, `A` - new price will be a sum of start price and `MarkupValue`, 'D' - if markup price not defined or should be deleted in <b>PUT</b> operation|
|`UsePriceType`|String||Yes, except when `MarkupType` is equal to 'D'|Source type for start price. Possible values are: `A` - average cost for product, `F` - latest fixed supplier cost for product, `L` - latest supplier cost for product,`V` - `MarkupValue` field is used as calculated price as is|
|`MarkupValue`|Decimal||Yes, except when `MarkupType` is equal to 'D'| Value is equal to or greater than 0. It is used in according with `MarkupType`. If UsePriceType is equal to `V`, it is used as calculated markup price|

## Markup Prices

Path: `/ref/markupprices`

<a id="get-product-markupprices"></a>
### GET /product/markupprices?ProductID={ProductID}
+ Method will return all markup price tiers. If markup does not exist, `MarkupType` will be equal to `D`.

Parameters:
- `ProductID` (required): Returns detailed info of a particular Product Markup Prices

<a id="put-product-markupprices"></a>
### PUT /product/markupprices
+ If markup line for given price tier does not exist, it will be created. If markup line for given price tier exists, it will be updated. If markup line has `MarkupType` equal to `D`, markup line will be deleted.

Request body:

```json
{'ProductID':'7C8795C2-1A6B-4318-BA72-291F61444906',
    'MarkupPrices':[
    {
        "TierNumber": 1,
        "MarkupType": "A",
        "UsePriceType": "A",
        "MarkupValue": 11
    },
    {
        "TierNumber": 3,
        "MarkupType": "D"
    }
    ]
}
```
